/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L58: Calvin: Nope, not yet! I haven't been there before, but it's on my to-do list for after my tour with Frank Ocean ends. Can't wait to see them in person! Look at that snowy peak.
/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-14.md:L21: Calvin: As you know, I had an amazing experience touring with a well-known artist. The feeling of performing and connecting with the audience was unreal. We ended with a show in Japan and then I had the opportunity to explore my new place - it's like a dream come true!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-03.md:L36: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L58: Calvin: Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank! I'm buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like. Gonna be great playing for folks from home. What do you think of the music scene there?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave! Great to hear from you, card night sounds like a blast! Always love having fun with friends. Guess what? I scored a deal to continue collaboration with Frank Ocean! This is a dream come true for me, I've been working hard and it's finally paying off. No words can describe how happy I am.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L22: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I had the opportunity to meet Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and we clicked. We've been speaking and sharing ideas we arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at my mansion - it's been great!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-15.md:L41: Calvin: Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-16.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no chat! How was the end of your tour? I bet it was amazing!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-16.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave! The tour was amazing! I was so pumped from all the energy from the audience. This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L30: Calvin: Thanks Dave! Lots of cool stuff happening. Next up, a tour - so excited! After that, I'm off to explore and grow my brand. Can't wait to see what the future has in store!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L33: Dave: Wow, Calvin! Congrats on the upcoming tour! Can't wait to see you perform. Do you have any cities or venues in mind?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-18.md:L39: Dave: That sounds awesome, Calvin! Live music is the best. I'm sure you're gonna have a blast on tour and make some awesome memories. If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-23.md:L40: Calvin: Wow, I heard great things about The Fireworks! Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. Seeing them perform live must've been awesome - I bet the energy was electric! That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Been a few days since we talked, but lots happened. Started touring with Frank Ocean and it's been amazing - so much energy from the crowd, such a connection when I'm on stage - unreal! Take a look at how I performed on stage, that was awesome!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L16: Dave: Congrats, Calvin! That's awesome. Being able to play your music to a crowd and feel that connection must be unreal. How's the tour going?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L19: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! The tour has been great, the energy from the crowd is awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true. It's been amazing!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-24.md:L66: Calvin: Cool, Dave! I'm actually going to Tokyo next month after the tour ends. Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like the one in the photo below. What a great view!
/memories/music-and-performance/session-25.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, how's the tour with Frank Ocean? I was pondering our chat the other day about fame and its impact on relationships. It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too. How are you juggling your job plus your personal life?
/memories/music-and-performance/session-25.md:L15: Calvin: The tour's been incredible! Performing and connecting with the crowd has been so energizing. Yeah, fame has its own challenges. It's been tough trying to balance everything.

/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-04.md:L53: Dave: Yeah, Calvin! It's such an amazing feeling to see something you create become a reality. Knowing that your skills and hard work made it happen is incredible.

/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-09.md:L36: Dave: That's great to hear! Skilled and knowledgeable people working on your car - are you feeling confident?

/memories/cars-and-auto-work/session-28.md:L45: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's awesome people are checking out my blog and asking me for advice. I recently posted about how I made this car look like a beast, and it was great to hear it inspired others to start their own DIY projects.

/memories/music-and-performance/session-07.md:L28: Dave: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-25.md:L55: Dave: Ever since I was ten, I've been fascinated with how machines work. I found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked if I could fix it. That's when my love for car engineering began! I enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made me hooked—so I've been working on cars ever since.
/memories/music-and-performance/session-25.md:L59: Calvin: Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life. Was it a classic car? Do you still have it or are you currently working on another project?
/memories/photography/session-30.md:L78: Calvin: Thank you for asking, Dave! Yes, I have a few more great news! I've accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston!
